_comment: Edit this file for your local setup. See README.md for the full explanation of each field.
_models_staging_dir_comment: Scratch slot for a fine-tuned candidate awaiting the doctor's approve/discard decision. Cleared and rewritten on every /api/train call -- never accumulates.
_gbl_pipeline_script_path_comment: Point this at the REAL build_gbl_pipeline.py inside your actual Simplicity Studio firmware project (it must stay next to its sibling config/tflite, cmake_gcc/build, autogen dirs). Only works when this app runs on the Windows machine with the Silicon Labs SDK + Simplicity Commander installed. Leave null to use the mock fallback everywhere else.
